subject: AndroidInteraction status: classifier baseline, class imbalance
body:
Hi Ulla, Daniela,

Status. The interaction-required classifier reaches 0.71 F1 on held-out episodes using the accessibility tree plus the low-level step instruction. Screenshots add almost nothing on top of the tree, which is a nice result for latency — we can skip the vision encoder in a v1.

Risk: class imbalance. Only about 14% of the 3,605 steps are annotated as requiring interaction, so a model that never asks scores 86% accuracy and is useless. We're reporting precision/recall on the positive class only. Recall is currently 0.58, meaning the agent silently guesses on four in ten steps where a human would have asked. That's the number to put in front of leadership, not F1.

Csilla
